name: bit2beat
description: Listen to Earth data: NASA climate series, live natural events and pictures turned into music, scores and spatial audio. NASA Space Apps 2026 — Earth Information Jukebox.

scripts.check: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const p=require('path');const walk=d=>fs.readdirSync(d,{withFileTypes:true}).flatMap(e=>e.isDirectory()?walk(p.join(d,e.name)):e.name.endsWith('.js')?[p.join(d,e.name)]:[]);for(const f of walk('src/js'))require('child_process').execFileSync(process.execPath,['--check',f]);console.log('syntax ok')"
